# JSK (Alejandro Fernandez) — Counter-Strike 2 Esports Player Dossier

> Official concise competitive dossier and verified player profile for Alejandro Fernandez "JSK".

## Identity & Core Facts
- **Nickname**: JSK
- **Real Name**: Alejandro Fernandez
- **Discipline**: Counter-Strike 2 (CS2)
- **Primary Tactical Role**: Entry Fragger / Rifler
- **Secondary Role**: Lurker / Coach
- **Nationality**: Argentine
- **Country & Location**: Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina
- **Current Status**: Free Agent / Stand by (Available for international & South American team offers)
- **Languages**: Spanish (Native)
- **Competitive Experience**: 24+ years active (Since 2001, CS 1.5 to CS2)

## Tactical Profile
First-contact initiator and high-tempo rifler specialized in site opening duels, space creation, and lurk timings. Decades of competitive LAN and online experience across all iterations of Counter-Strike (1.5, 1.6, Global Offensive, CS2).

## Competitive Ranks
- **FACEIT**: Level 9 (1,820 ELO) — Verified
- **GamersClub**: Level 20 (2,902 ELO) — Verified

- **Copa Profesional Sudamericana (2024, CS2)**: 1st Place (Champion)
- **ReDragon Battle Series S1 (2024, CS2)**: 2nd Place
- **Torneo CSGO LAN PuntoNet (2014, CS:GO)**: 1st Place
- **Liga Open GamersClub (2019, CS:GO)**: 2nd Place
- **Challenge The Stars LAN (CS 1.6)**: 1st Place (Qualy) / 2nd Place
- **Cyber Andromeda & Hardex LANs (CS 1.5)**: Multiple 1st Places
